Module com.stockle
Package com.stockle.database

Interface TradeDAO

All Known Implementing Classes:
SQLTradeDAO
public interface TradeDAO
TradeDAO is an interface that defines the methods for interacting with the trade data in the database. It provides methods for adding, deleting, updating, and retrieving trades, as well as handling profit calculations.
